x: Zidovudine (AZT) is an antiretroviral drug for HIV/AIDS. Albendazole kills worms and quinine treats malaria.
t: Recall the drug for each disease.

x: Option C is incorrect: the diphtheria toxoid vaccine prevents the disease; it does not treat it. Nets and DDT prevent malaria, and albendazole treats ascariasis.
t: Discriminate prevention from treatment.

x: Both are true and R explains A: Claviceps purpurea makes ergot alkaloids, and eating them causes ergotism.
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.

x: PKU comes from lack of phenylalanine hydroxylase, Down syndrome from non-disjunction, Turner syndrome from a missing X, and alkaptonuria is autosomal recessive, giving a-iv, b-i, c-iii, d-ii.
t: Recall the cause of each genetic disorder.

x: I, III and IV are correct: Down syndrome comes from non-disjunction, Klinefelter's from an extra X (XXY) and SCID from gene mutations. II is false because Turner syndrome has a missing X (XO).
t: Discriminate Turner (XO) from Klinefelter (XXY).

x: All six are antimalarials: chloroquine, amodiaquine, atovaquone, proguanil, mefloquine and primaquine.
t: Recall the antimalarial drugs.

x: Both are true: antibiotics and sulpha drugs both treat bacterial infections.
t: Recall the drugs for bacterial diseases.

x: Both are true and R explains A: Clostridium botulinum's toxin, not the bacteria themselves, causes botulism, so it is toxin-mediated.
t: Check whether R is the cause of A.

x: P-32 and Co-60 are both used in radiotherapy for leukaemia, and radioisotopes are used in cancer diagnosis and treatment. Pairing in order gives a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall that the code pairs items in order when List-II repeats.

x: All four are correct: chloramphenicol, a broad-spectrum antibiotic, treats meningitis, plague, cholera and typhoid.
t: Recall the uses of chloramphenicol.

x: Cobalt-60 gives off gamma rays that are used in radiotherapy to kill cancer cells.
t: Recall the medical uses of radioisotopes.

x: All three are correct: epidemic dropsy comes from mustard oil adulterated with argemone oil, which contains sanguinarine and dihydrosanguinarine.
t: Recall the cause of epidemic dropsy.

x: Aflatoxin, a liver toxin and carcinogen, is made by Aspergillus flavus and Aspergillus parasiticus on stored grains and nuts.
t: Recall the source of aflatoxin.

x: All four are correct: Aspergillus flavus and A. parasiticus make aflatoxin, and Amanita mushrooms contain the deadly α-amanitin.
t: Recall the fungal toxins.

x: Both are true but R does not explain A: X-linked inheritance explains who gets haemophilia, not that the cause is a faulty clotting-factor gene.
t: Check whether R explains the cause or only the inheritance.

x: Both are true: PKU is autosomal recessive, and albinism is recessive, caused by faulty or missing tyrosinase.
t: Recall the inheritance of metabolic disorders.

x: Alkaptonuria comes from mutation of the HGD gene, so homogentisic acid builds up and turns urine black. Albinism involves tyrosinase.
t: Recall the gene behind each disorder.

x: Muscular dystrophy is an X-linked muscle-protein defect, sickle-cell a single-gene haemoglobin mutation, thalassaemia inherited faulty haemoglobin production, and colour blindness X-linked, giving a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall the cause of each genetic disorder.

x: All three are chromosomal: Down syndrome (trisomy 21), Turner (XO) and Klinefelter (XXY).
t: Discriminate chromosomal from single-gene disorders.

x: SCID (bubble baby syndrome) is a genetic disorder of the immune system, the first treated by gene therapy.
t: Recall the nature of SCID.

x: An endemic disease is always present in a particular region or population, such as malaria in some areas. Epidemics are sudden rises and pandemics worldwide.
t: Discriminate endemic, epidemic and pandemic.

x: Option C is incorrect: Ebola's first simultaneous outbreaks were in 1976, not 2011. The definitions of endemic, pandemic and epidemic are right.
t: Recall the dates of outbreaks.

x: Both are true but R does not explain A: being an animal disease does not explain eradication; mass vaccination ended rinderpest in 2011.
t: Check whether R is a cause or only a description.

x: Rice blast is caused by Pyricularia, rice khaira by zinc deficiency, potato early blight by Alternaria solani and mustard white rust by Albugo candida, giving a-ii, b-i, c-iv, d-iii.
t: Recall the cause of each crop disease.

x: I, II and IV are correct: khaira is zinc deficiency, Karnal bunt is Tilletia indica, and okra yellow vein mosaic is a whitefly-spread virus. III is false because black heart is lack of oxygen; Phytophthora causes late blight.
t: Discriminate black heart from late blight.

x: COVID-19 was a pandemic, and Nipah had outbreaks in Kerala. 1976 outbreaks were Ebola, and 2011 eradication was rinderpest.
t: Recall the facts about each outbreak.

x: All four are correct: Ranikhet is a viral disease of chickens, bird flu (H5N1) of poultry, swine flu (H1N1) of pigs and foot-and-mouth (Aphthovirus) of cloven-hoofed animals.
t: Recall the host and pathogen of each animal disease.

x: Anthrax is caused by Bacillus anthracis, black quarter by Clostridium chauvoei, cowpox by cowpox virus and rinderpest by Morbillivirus, giving a-ii, b-iii, c-iv, d-i.
t: Recall the pathogen of each animal disease.

x: Rice brown leaf spot is caused by Sphaerulina oryzina, tungro by RTSV and RTBV viruses, wheat black rust by Puccinia graminis and loose smut by Ustilago nuda, giving a-iv, b-ii, c-iii, d-i.
t: Recall the pathogen of each crop disease.

x: Ear cockle of wheat is caused by the nematode Anguina tritici. Colletotrichum causes red rot and Pyrilla is a sugarcane insect.
t: Recall the pathogen of each crop disease.

x: Both are true but R does not explain A: Pyrilla is an insect pest of sugarcane, unrelated to the fungus that causes red rot.
t: Check whether R is related to A.

x: Potato wart is caused by Synchytrium, groundnut tikka by Cercospora, bajra green ear by Sclerospora and bajra ergot by Claviceps, giving a-ii, b-iii, c-iv, d-i.
t: Recall the pathogen of each crop disease.

x: All four are correct: Fusarium causes arhar wilt, Xanthomonas axonopodis citrus canker, X. campestris cabbage black rot and Pseudomonas potato wilt.
t: Recall the pathogen of each crop disease.

x: Both are true: zinc deficiency causes citrus mottle (little leaf) and white bud of maize.
t: Recall the zinc deficiency diseases.

x: Internal cork of apple comes from boron deficiency. Zinc lack causes khaira and molybdenum lack whiptail.
t: Recall the micronutrient deficiency diseases.

x: Whiptail of cabbage and cauliflower comes from molybdenum deficiency. Zinc lack causes khaira and boron lack internal cork.
t: Recall the micronutrient deficiency diseases.

x: Claviceps purpurea, the ergot fungus of rye and bajra, causes ergotism. Aspergillus flavus makes aflatoxin and Albugo causes white rust.
t: Recall the fungus behind each disease.

x: Option C is incorrect: H5N1 causes bird flu, while swine flu is H1N1. The polio, chikungunya and COVID-19 pairings are right.
t: Discriminate H5N1 (bird flu) from H1N1 (swine flu).

x: Both are true but R does not explain A: Mycobacterium causing tuberculosis is unrelated to Clostridium causing tetanus.
t: Check whether R is related to A.

x: Colletotrichum falcatum causes sugarcane red rot, Puccinia graminis wheat black rust, Alternaria solani potato early blight and Cercospora groundnut tikka, giving a-iii, b-iv, c-ii, d-i.
t: Recall the pathogen of each crop disease.

x: I, II and III are correct: Ebola virus causes Ebola, Morbillivirus rinderpest and Aphthovirus foot-and-mouth disease. IV is false because yellow fever has its own virus.
t: Recall the virus behind each disease.

x: Three cause athlete's foot: Trichophyton, Epidermophyton and Microsporum. The two Aspergillus species make aflatoxin.
t: Recall the fungi behind athlete's foot.

x: All four are correct: Mucormycetes cause mucormycosis, Ustilago loose smut, Phytophthora potato late blight and Synchytrium potato wart.
t: Recall the fungus behind each disease.

x: Albugo candida causes mustard white rust, Pyricularia rice blast, Claviceps ergotism and Alternaria potato early blight, giving a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall the fungus behind each disease.

x: HBV causes hepatitis B, HIV AIDS, JEV Japanese encephalitis and Nipah virus Nipah, giving a-iii, b-i, c-iv, d-ii.
t: Recall the virus behind each disease.

x: Vibrio cholerae causes cholera, Yersinia pestis plague, Mycobacterium leprae leprosy and Streptococcus pneumoniae pneumonia, giving a-i, b-ii, c-iii, d-iv.
t: Recall the bacterium behind each disease.

x: Both are true but R does not explain A: Corynebacterium causing diphtheria is unrelated to Salmonella causing typhoid.
t: Check whether R is related to A.

x: Neisseria gonorrhoeae causes gonorrhoea, Treponema pallidum syphilis and Bordetella pertussis whooping cough, giving a-iii, b-i, c-ii.
t: Recall the bacterium behind each disease.

x: Both are true but R does not explain A: Clostridium causing botulism is unrelated to Streptococcus causing rheumatic fever.
t: Check whether R is related to A.

x: Xanthomonas axonopodis causes citrus canker, X. campestris black rot of cabbage and Agrobacterium tumefaciens crown gall, giving a-iii, b-ii, c-i.
t: Recall the bacterium behind each plant disease.

x: Both are true but R does not explain A: dengue virus causing dengue is an independent fact unrelated to rabies.
t: Check whether R is related to A.

x: All four are correct: TMV causes tobacco mosaic, RTSV and RTBV rice tungro, H1N1 swine flu and Nipah virus Nipah disease.
t: Recall the virus behind each disease.
